title: KiasuParents
line: Singapore's online community and resource hub for parents.
problem: KiasuParents is a widely-used online community and resource hub for parents in Singapore, with lots of articles and very active forums. The website brings several systems together: WordPress, Strapi CMS, Mautic and NodeBB, behind a Next.js frontend.
did: As part of the Amber Creative team, I implemented new webpages, improved the application's performance and fixed bugs across its key modules. I also handled continuous content updates based on the client's requirements.
outcome: New features for thousands of parents in Singapore, on a faster and more stable website.

story.title: Situation
story.body: KiasuParents is a widely-used online community and resource hub for parents in Singapore, with lots of articles and very active forums. The website brings several systems together: WordPress, Strapi CMS, Mautic and NodeBB, behind a Next.js frontend.

story.title: Task
story.body: As part of the Amber Creative team, my job was to add the new pages and features the client asked for, while keeping the website fast and stable for its users.

story.title: Action
story.body:
I implemented new webpages with Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, and improved the application's performance. I fixed bugs across its key modules and handled continuous content updates based on the client's requirements.

Along the way, I gained experience with managing content workflows, administrative tasks and backend operations.

story.title: Result
story.body: New features for thousands of parents in Singapore, on a faster and more stable website.

notes: Written with STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result). To make the Result stronger, add real figures if you have them, e.g. which pages you built or any speed improvements you measured.
